mapper.select: SELECT l.id AS lineId,m.code AS materialCode,m.name AS materialName, w.code AS warehouseCode,w.name AS warehouseName,w.source AS warehouseSource,u.name AS unitName FROM wm_stock_document_line l LEFT JOIN material m ON m.id=l.material_id LEFT JOIN wm_warehouse w ON w.id=l.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN unit_measure u ON u.id=l.unit_id WHERE l.document_id=#{id} ORDER BY l.line_no,l.id

SELECT a.id AS id, a.document_line_id AS documentLineId, a.action_type AS actionType, a.quantity_delta AS quantityDelta, a.occurred_at AS occurredAt, a.reference_action_id AS referenceActionId, a.operation_id AS operationId, a.stock_id AS stockId, a.batch_no AS batchNo, a.bin_code AS binCode, a.operator_user_id AS operatorUserId, a.reason AS reason FROM wm_stock_action a JOIN wm_stock_document_line l ON l.id=a.document_line_id AND l.document_id=#{id} WHERE a.source_id=CAST(#{id} AS CHAR) AND a.source_type IN (#{materialIssueSource},#{otherIssueSource},#{otherReceiptSource}) ORDER BY a.occurred_at,a.recorded_at,a.id
SELECT p.id FROM wm_stock_document d JOIN wm_stock_document p ON p.id=d.paired_document_id WHERE d.id=#{id}
mapper.sql: FROM wm_stock_document d LEFT JOIN wm_stock_document_line l ON l.document_id=d.id LEFT JOIN wm_stock_action a ON a.id=l.stock_action_id LEFT JOIN mes_production_execution e ON e.execution_code=d.source_execution_code LEFT JOIN workorder o ON o.id=e.workorder_id LEFT JOIN material m ON m.id=e.product_id LEFT JOIN wm_warehouse w ON w.id=l.warehouse_id WHERE d.source_execution_code=#{executionCode} AND d.status=#{postedStatus} AND d.document_type=#{productionReceiptType}

e.id IS NOT NULL AND o.id IS NOT NULL AND m.id IS NOT NULL AND w.id IS NOT NULL AND o.source=#{localSource} AND w.source=#{localSource} AND e.product_id=o.product_id AND l.material_id=e.product_id AND l.unit_id=m.unit_id AND l.quantity>0 AND d.source_workorder_id IS NULL AND d.post_request_id IS NOT NULL AND d.post_request_hash IS NOT NULL AND d.posted_by IS NOT NULL AND d.posted_at IS NOT NULL AND a.id IS NOT NULL AND a.document_line_id=l.id AND a.execution_code=#{executionCode} AND a.operation_id=d.post_request_id AND a.source_type=#{receiptSourceType} AND a.source_id=CONCAT('',d.id) AND a.action_type=#{receiptActionType} AND a.quantity_delta=l.quantity AND a.available_delta=l.quantity AND a.quantity_after-a.quantity_before=l.quantity AND a.available_after-a.available_before=l.quantity AND a.operator_user_id=d.posted_by AND a.request_hash=d.post_request_hash AND a.reference_action_id IS NULL AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wm_stock_action duplicate_action WHERE duplicate_action.document_line_id=l.id)=1 AND a.stock_id=l.stock_id AND a.material_id=l.material_id AND a.warehouse_id=l.warehouse_id AND a.unit_id=l.unit_id
AND CAST(a.batch_no AS BINARY(512))=CAST(l.batch_no AS BINARY(512)) AND OCTET_LENGTH(a.batch_no)=OCTET_LENGTH(l.batch_no) AND CAST(l.batch_no AS BINARY(512))=CAST(e.batch_no AS BINARY(512)) AND OCTET_LENGTH(l.batch_no)=OCTET_LENGTH(e.batch_no) AND ((CAST(a.bin_code AS BINARY(256))=CAST(l.bin_code AS BINARY(256)) AND OCTET_LENGTH(a.bin_code)=OCTET_LENGTH(l.bin_code)) OR (a.bin_code IS NULL AND l.bin_code IS NULL))
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(f.quantity),0) FROM ( SELECT l.quantity FROM wm_stock_document d JOIN wm_stock_document_line l ON l.document_id=d.id JOIN wm_stock_action a ON a.id=l.stock_action_id AND a.document_line_id=l.id AND a.execution_code=d.source_execution_code WHERE d.source_execution_code=#{executionCode} AND d.status=#{posted} AND d.document_type IN (#{receipt},#{productionReceipt}) UNION ALL SELECT quantity_delta FROM mes_warehouse_acceptance WHERE execution_code=#{executionCode} ) f
